description: Mark a SWSD incident sub-task as complete or incomplete. Pass `completed: true` to set the task to "Completed", or `completed: false` to revert to "New". For finer state control (e.g., "In Progress"), use the SWSD UI directly — this tool is the safer wrapper for the common done/not-done transition. WRITE — idempotent: re-applying the same value is a no-op on SWSD.

completed.description: True to mark the task complete ("Completed"); false to mark it incomplete ("New").

incident_id.description: SWSD incident reference. Accepts either the internal id (>=7 digits, e.g. 180457930) or the human-facing number (<=6 digits, e.g. 60310). The handler auto-detects via digit count.

name: swsd_update_task_state
